entry.title: Updated: dsh-token-pet
entry.summary: Cute token-usage widget in the session header: a Bubu doll plus context occupancy, session usage and breakdown, with date/weekday, weather, 3-day forecast and severe-weather alerts (raindrop/snowflake animation), following the theme color.
